function.name: set_device_state
function.description: Turns a specific smart home device or appliance on or off.

device.description: The name of the device (e.g., lights, coffee maker, garage door, humidifier, security camera).

state.description: The desired operational state of the device.

room.description: Optional room location of the device (e.g., living room, kitchen, garage, backyard).

function.name: get_device_status
function.description: Retrieves the current real-time status or state of a smart appliance.

device.description: The name of the device to query (e.g., front door lock, garage door, washing machine, coffee maker).

function.name: set_security_mode
function.description: Sets the operational mode of the home security system.

function.name: set_climate
function.description: Adjusts the climate control or smart thermostat temperature setting for a room.

room.description: The designated room or zone (e.g., kitchen).

temperature.description: The target temperature value in degrees Celsius.

function.name: bulk_control_plugs
function.description: Controls all smart plugs simultaneously while allowing specific exclusions.

state.description: The power state to apply to the plugs.

exclude.description: List of specific plug names to exempt from the action.

function.name: set_light_brightness
function.description: Changes the brightness level of dimmable smart lights.

room.description: The room containing the lights (e.g., bedroom, backyard).

brightness.description: The brightness level expressed as a percentage from 1 to 100.

device.description: Optional specific light device name (e.g., patio lights).

function.name: play_media
function.description: Plays music or media stream matching a genre or playlist targeting a specific room speaker.

genre.description: The style or mood classification of the audio.

function.name: set_media_timer
function.description: Configures a sleep countdown timer to automatically shut off running media.

room.description: The room containing the active media session.

duration_minutes.description: Timer length in minutes before cutoff execution.

function.name: broadcast_message
function.description: Broadcasts a text-to-speech voice message out of a smart home audio speaker.

message.description: The explicit text phrase to announce.

function.name: control_vacuum
function.description: Issues localized movement controls to a robotic vacuum system.

zone.description: Optional physical target zone restriction (e.g., hallway).

function.name: get_sensor_data
function.description: Queries discrete reading data from environmental sensors.

sensor_type.description: The sensor telemetry type to fetch.

function.name: set_device_mode
function.description: Updates specific internal execution algorithms of an appliance.

device.description: The appliance profile target name (e.g., humidifier).

mode.description: The desired running routine setting (e.g., auto, eco, manual).

function.name: set_light_color
function.description: Modifies the current colour profile of color-changing RGB smart lights.

device.description: The target lighting element fixture name.

color.description: The target colour string value (e.g., blue, red, green).

function.name: brew_beverage
function.description: Commands a smart coffee maker tool to start brewing an explicit drink type selection.
